reviewer: allocation_independent subagent; static mapping review plus artificial validation

artificial_tests.command: python -m pytest tests/test_allocation_study.py tests/test_allocation_signals.py tests/test_allocation_runner.py tests/test_allocation_accounting.py

reviewed_rules: Six frozen source assets and hashes, joint observed calendar, adjusted open/close wealth units without added dividends
Twelve policies, three windows, three friction rates and 108 predeclared accounts
126 daily returns through prior completed month-end, half-diagonal covariance shrinkage, capped minimum variance and equal risk contribution
126 finite-grid experts with gross monthly signal wealth, EG eta0.05 and causal month-end updates
Each CPPI/ratchet scenario uses its own previous actual costed closing NAV and prior close peak, fixed800 or0.8peak floor, multiplier3 and one0.98 budget
Only next observed open entries/rebalances; buyhold controls initial only; final closing liquidation includes costs
Fresh1000 per scenario, funded self-financing trades, no leverage/shorting/borrowing
Training ranking saved before evaluation/full simulations; allzero/loss years and cost variants retained
Setup signal error receipt and trial failure row retained; failures abort rather than being labeled completed
Independent checker imports no new strategy engine or signals; reconstructs all cash-flow/price/annual/drawdown/target/selection comparisons
pre_performance_status: No historical account performance was computed or inspected by this reviewer before this receipt. Artificial fixtures only.
limits: Static and fixture validation does not guarantee absence of software defects
Historical source knowledge is not an untouched holdout
All 108 historical accounts still require independent reconciliation after execution
Synthetic close timestamps and fractional adjusted units are not proof of broker execution feasibility
